title: Possessives
summary: Use possessive forms to show who something belongs to.

explanation.en: Possessive adjectives come before a noun. Possessive pronouns replace the noun.
explanation.ru: Притяжательные прилагательные стоят перед существительным, а притяжательные местоимения заменяют существительное.

forms.label: Possessive adjectives
forms.pattern: my · your · his · her · its · our · their + noun

forms.label: Possessive pronouns
forms.pattern: mine · yours · his · hers · ours · theirs

commonMistakes.note: Use my before a noun; mine without a noun.
For people, possessive 's is usually the natural form.
